verdict.rationale: Runpod documents official Serverless SDKs for Python, JavaScript, and Go for interacting with endpoints programmatically. It also ships the official `@runpod/ai-sdk-provider` package for the Vercel AI SDK and Flash for running Python functions on remote GPUs via `@Endpoint`. Missing for 10: evidence that the SDKs cover Pod, volume, and cluster management beyond Serverless and Public Endpoints, depth of SDK reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
